style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

⟦0⟧ starts with 13 mountain divisions, which cannot be modified, deleted or trained by default. It is only allowed to train up to 15 Militia divisions at the start of the game.
The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.
Keeping good relations with surrounding countries helps to deter an eventual invasion of Switzerland, especially from the German Reich and Fascist Italy.

Build up your industry (both civilian and military) as that allows you to build fortifications and equip and field a larger army and airforce, both as a deterrent against invasion. Since the game does not mandate historical gameplay, it is possible to change ideology to fascism and use the Generic National Focus Tree to gain +7% more recruitable manpower to mobilize, in addition to making more extreme conscription laws more freely available. At that point, however, there arises the question about whether or not to abandon neutrality altogether and actively join the axis to try and profit off the war and earn a slice of the cake in the form of annexed land or puppets. It is up to the player to decide that. One good example is to join wars with Germany when Germany attacks France, this way Switzerland can gain victory points and have control over some French states. However, watchout for the manpower and equipment required to supply the garrison troops

Fortifying the country (especially the borders) by building Land Forts and Anti-Air makes the AI less likely to attack you. At Fort level 6 and above, the AI will straight-up refuse to attack your defensive line.

After taking the "Expand the Confederation" focus, by simply maxxing out on political power gain (not taking any focuses and not appointing any advisors), the decisions to promote ideology and referendums in neighboring providences becomes available. This causes your neighboring countries to lose cores and for Switzerland to gain cores on said territories. While this takes forever, and is repetitive, it is a bloodless way to take over nearly the entirety of the eastern hemisphere and gain cores on all controlled territory. (Note: After having an empty political advisor slot there are debuffs to your nation, these debuffs do not stack so it is fine to leave the debuff as is in order to save up some more political power).
